title: Red Hat Security Advisory: java-21-openjdk security update for RHEL 8 and 9
description: Red Hat has issued a critical security update for the java-21-openjdk packages in Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8 and 9. The update addresses multiple vulnerabilities in the OpenJDK 21 Java Runtime Environment and Software Development Kit, including issues related to Kerberos tickets, StringBuilder checks, JFR events, loop handling, vector masks, integer compression, JMX connections, Base64 optimization, and TLS client connections. These fixes resolve potential security weaknesses that could lead to remote code execution and other impacts. Users of affected Red Hat Enterprise Linux versions are advised to apply the update promptly.
